title: Dropping and taking padded sources
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $f$ map bit sources to Boolean values, and let $\mathrm{pre}$ and $\mathrm{rest}$ be lists of bit sources. Mapping $f$ over the padded concatenation $\mathrm{pre}++\mathrm{rest}$, then dropping $|\mathrm{pre}|$ entries and taking $|\mathrm{rest}|$ entries, gives exactly the list obtained by mapping $f$ over $\mathrm{rest}$.
